items.difficulty_reason: The lemma describes the subsheaf of a quasi-coherent sheaf of algebras consisting of the elements whose stalks are integral over the local rings: it is a quasi-coherent algebra, its stalks are the integral closures of the local rings in the stalks of the ambient sheaf, and on affine opens it computes the integral closure of the corresponding ring extension. The proof verifies the subsheaf condition from the local nature of integrality, uses the algebra result that integral elements form a subring to see that the collection is a sheaf of algebras, and then compares the definition with the affine description of integral closures, which yields both the stalk and the affine-Open statements.
